# GLOBE upstream information

Source repository: https://github.com/osman-mian/Globe

Paper: [Discovering Fully Oriented Causal Networks](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/17085), AAAI 2021.

The upstream README identifies the license as MIT. The bundled modules include adjustments to rpy2 data conversion. See the [software requirements](../../docs/software.md) and the [GLOBE wrapper](../../shared/baselines/globe.py).
